note: Rewritten from the original English description of Snyder 1934; original in English, describing the alate only (type locality Hamburg Farm, Costa Rica, at light); the measurements in the original are single values or ranges and are transcribed verbatim, without rounding.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Characterised by the large, transparent, pear-shaped fontanelle, which is larger than in punctatus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head chestnut brown, densely covered with long hairs; fontanelle large, transparent, pear-shaped, slightly smaller than the ocellus; postclypeus yellowish brown, three times as wide as long; eyes black, not circular, close against the sides of the head; ocelli transparent, almost elliptical, projecting, their distance from the eye less than the diameter of the ocellus; mandibular margins reddish brown. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 or 4. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, posterior margin shallowly concave, densely covered with long hairs. Wings grey, costal area yellowish brown, surface finely punctate and hairy; media of the forewing branching slightly above the middle of the wing and reaching the wing apex, nearer the cubitus than the subcosta. Abdominal tergites greyish brown, densely covered with long hairs. Measurements: female alate total length 10.50—11.00 mm, male 10.00—10.50 mm; female dealate 6.00 mm, male 5.00—5.50 mm; head length 1.20 mm; left mandible length 0.60 mm; pronotum length 0.60 mm; hind tibia length 1.00 mm; female forewing length 9.00 mm; eye length 0.25 mm; head width (at the eyes) 0.95—1.00 mm; pronotum width 0.70 mm; female forewing width 3.20 mm.
